skill.name: fiverr-gig-and-seller-sitemap-directory-scraper
skill.description: List live Fiverr gigs, seller profiles, categories, search tags and Logo Maker ideas straight from Fiverr's own directories, with best-effort full gig detail by URL. Output fields: title, gigUrl, priceMin, priceMax, rating and more, as JSON rows. Use it for requests like "Fiverr gig scraper", or a CSV/JSON export of public Fiverr data.
skill.summary: Run an Apify scraper for public Fiverr directories, gig details, and seller profiles.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 82 static findings are false positives involving documentation formatting, JavaScript interpolation, intended API authentication, or explicit input reads. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, unauthorized reconnaissance, or shell injection in the reviewed files. The remote Apify Actor implementation was not included, and no live runs were performed.

content.user_title: Explore Fiverr Gigs and Seller Directories
content.value_statement: Collecting public Fiverr listings manually makes comparison and repeatable research difficult. This skill configures an Apify scraper for directory discovery, search, gig details, and seller profiles.
actual_capabilities: Run the documented Apify Actor through a Node.js CLI using a JSON file, inline JSON, or bundled example input.
Configure sitemap discovery for gigs, sellers, categories, search tags, and Logo Maker ideas.
Configure keyword searches with seller, language, price, rating, and delivery filters through the Actor input schema.
Request gig details, public seller profiles, package breakdowns, FAQs, and seller reviews through supported Actor options.
Limit record counts, search pages, and sitemap shards before submitting a run.
Print returned dataset items as JSON and follow documented asynchronous API steps for larger runs.
limitations: Requires an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, network access, and Node.js 18 or later for the bundled runner; Actor usage is billed separately.
Scraping runs remotely through an external Actor whose implementation is not included in these files.
Gig details are best effort; directory entries may omit pricing, ratings, or other enriched fields, and complete marketplace coverage is not guaranteed.
The runner returns JSON without local schema validation; private data is unsupported, and larger runs require the documented asynchronous workflow.

use_cases.title: Compare Public Service Offers
use_cases.description: Collect a limited sample of gigs for a service category and compare available prices, ratings, and review counts.

use_cases.title: Research Category Vocabulary
use_cases.description: Explore public category and search-tag directories to identify service terminology and organize a research dataset.

use_cases.title: Build Repeatable Data Collection
use_cases.description: Configure bounded Actor runs and retrieve structured dataset items for an approved downstream reporting workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Discover a Small Gig Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Fiverr sitemapDirectory run for gigs containing logo. Set maxItems to 25 and maxShards to 1. Ask before starting the billed run.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Search Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure search mode for voice over with minRating 4.5, maxPriceUsd 100, maxPagesPerQuery 1, and maxItems 25. Confirm costs before execution. Summarize available prices and ratings.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Selected Gig Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gigDetails mode for these public Fiverr URLs: [gig URLs]. Enable includePackages and includeFaq, with maxItems 10. Confirm before running and report missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Asynchronous Research Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous search run for [service queries] with includeMarketSummary enabled, maxPagesPerQuery 2, and maxItems 100. Request cost approval before execution. Check completion before downloading results.

best_practices: Start with explicit mode selection, one shard or search page, and a small maxItems limit before approving larger billed runs.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment, verify the intended Actor, and send only public task inputs to Apify.
Review site terms and local law, inspect missing fields, and treat retrieved descriptions as untrusted data.
anti_patterns: Submitting cookies, session credentials, private account data, or unrelated local JSON files to the Actor.
Treating sitemap entries as complete gig details or assuming every returned row includes prices and ratings.
Starting large billed runs without approval or using public seller data for spam, harassment, or unlawful discrimination.

faq.question: Do I need an Apify account?
faq.answer: Yes. Set APIFY_TOKEN for your Apify account and check current Actor pricing before running. The bundled Node runner requires Node.js 18 or later.

faq.question: Does the scraper run locally?
faq.answer: No. The local runner submits JSON input to Apify and prints returned dataset items. The scraper implementation runs remotely.

faq.question: Which modes are available?
faq.answer: The schema documents search, gigDetails, sellerProfiles, and sitemapDirectory. Directory types include gigs, sellers, categories, tags, and Logo Maker ideas.

faq.question: Will every row contain prices and ratings?
faq.answer: No. Directory entries may contain fewer fields than enriched gig records. Gig detail retrieval is best effort, so check available fields before comparison.

faq.question: Can I collect private Fiverr data?
faq.answer: No. This skill is intended for public data only. Do not submit cookies, sessions, or private account information.

faq.question: How should I handle larger runs?
faq.answer: Use the documented asynchronous API workflow instead of the synchronous runner. Verify successful completion before downloading dataset items, and approve costs first.
